title: APP rank-weighted fixed-size subset likelihood
hypothesis: The exact APP ordinal ranking can be converted into a calibrated probability distribution over 5-number subsets using a fixed-size exponential tilt. If smaller APP ranks contain useful inclusion information, a positive rank-decay parameter selected only on Discovery should improve proper subset log score and marginal-inclusion Brier score on later Validation and Blind OOS targets versus the uniform 5-of-40 baseline.

model.subset_probability: P_beta(S|ranks)=exp(-beta*sum_{r in S} r)/Z(beta), for |S|=5 and ranks 1..40.
model.partition_function: Z(beta)=sum_{A subset {1..40}, |A|=5} exp(-beta*sum_{r in A} r), computed by exact elementary-symmetric-polynomial dynamic programming.

selection.rule: Select the beta with the highest mean Discovery log-likelihood gain; ties choose the smaller beta. Freeze that single beta for Validation and Blind OOS; no retuning.
selection.multiple_testing: Holm across Validation/Blind OOS x log-likelihood/Brier endpoints. Discovery grid is training selection; its 21 candidate values are not counted as independent confirmatory tests.

sample.split_rule: Chronological 60/20/remainder; first two split sizes rounded.

inference.randomization: Conditional Monte Carlo: independently sample a uniform 5-subset of ranks 1..40 for every target; compare aggregate log-likelihood gain upper tail and Brier-delta lower tail.
inference.sampler: Seeded xorshift32 plus rejection sampling to an acceptance range exactly divisible by 40; five distinct ranks sampled without replacement.
inference.bootstrap: Paired target-level circular moving-block bootstrap, block length 20, percentile 95% intervals.
assumptions: Official draws are independent uniform 5-of-40 subsets under the null.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
Q135 is an exploratory post-hoc extension of Q123, not independent confirmatory evidence.

leakage_controls: Use only the immutable Q123 rank ledger derived from the exact APP scorer on strict-prior prefixes.
Verify the source ledger Git blob SHA and every target index/date/history_cutoff.
Require history_cutoff < target_date and strictly chronological target rows.
Exclude 2026-11-11 and all later data; source ledger ends 2026-11-10.
Select beta on Discovery only; no Validation or Blind OOS retuning.
Verify the exact partition function at beta=0 equals C(40,5)=658008.
Verify marginal inclusion probabilities sum to five within numerical tolerance.
Replay randomization and bootstrap with fixed seeds.
Persist source, report, target ledger, validation, checkpoint and manifest.
decision_rule: Report a supportive exploratory result only if Blind OOS mean log-likelihood gain is positive with Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and Blind OOS Brier delta is negative. Otherwise record no demonstrated rank-subset likelihood lift. No production promotion or engine change.
guardrails: Research-only; no production scorer, archive, existing freeze, Q60 gate or metrics are modified.
No new prospective freeze is created by Q135.
No automatic merge or model promotion.
